owner_report: Owner selected Closed; prepare next preflight. Closure is owner-reported; no device reconnection occurred.
scope: One bounded read-only preflight, then only if successful, one exact temporary metadata-reader staging/run/owned-cleanup operation. No client upgrade, trust replacement, application/service restart, old experiment cleanup or hook bypass.

operations.on_nonzero: Stop immediately; no helper staging, no retry.

operations.requires: Operation 1 succeeds; no active production client; same boot and base directory identity; helper directory absent.
argv:
sh -c 'set -eu
fail() { printf '\''STOP=%s\n'\'' "$1" >&2; exit 41; }
[ "$(id -u)" = 0 ] || fail account
[ "$(cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id)" = '\''8e816d98-6bf4-4f9e-9abe-891fbf83d06f'\'' ] || fail boot_changed
base='\''/home/root/.local/share/pi-ink-bridge'\''
dir='\''/home/root/.local/share/pi-ink-bridge/.preflight-reader-0011'\''
helper='\''/home/root/.local/share/pi-ink-bridge/.preflight-reader-0011/metadata-reader'\''
for path in / /home /home/root /home/root/.local /home/root/.local/share "$base"; do
 [ -d "$path" ] && [ ! -L "$path" ] || fail parent_type
 [ "$(stat -c %u "$path")" = 0 ] || fail parent_owner
done
[ "$(stat -c '\''%d:%i:%u:%g:%a'\'' "$base")" = '\''65026:1150:0:0:700'\'' ] || fail base_identity_changed
for proc in /proc/[0-9]*; do
 exe=$(readlink "$proc/exe" 2>/dev/null || true)
 case "$exe" in *pi-ink-client*|*pi-annotations*) fail client_active;; esac
done
[ ! -e "$dir" ] && [ ! -L "$dir" ] || fail helper_directory_occupied
umask 077
mkdir -m 700 "$dir"
dir_identity=$(stat -c '\''%d:%i:%u:%g:%a'\'' "$dir")
set -C
cat > "$helper"
[ -f "$helper" ] && [ ! -L "$helper" ] || fail helper_type
[ "$(stat -c '\''%u:%g:%a:%s'\'' "$helper")" = '\''0:0:600:2162872'\'' ] || fail helper_metadata
printf '\''%s\n'\'' '\''0fe207302d7feb59fe6ff9a6beb407950d9fce9386522b533ad0868514d9e7ed  /home/root/.local/share/pi-ink-bridge/.preflight-reader-0011/metadata-reader'\'' | sha256sum -c -
chmod 700 "$helper"
helper_identity=$(stat -c '\''%d:%i:%u:%g:%a:%s'\'' "$helper")
printf '\''READER_DIRECTORY_IDENTITY=%s\nREADER_FILE_IDENTITY=%s\n'\'' "$dir_identity" "$helper_identity"
"$helper"
[ -d "$dir" ] && [ ! -L "$dir" ] || fail cleanup_directory_type
[ "$(stat -c '\''%d:%i:%u:%g:%a'\'' "$dir")" = "$dir_identity" ] || fail cleanup_directory_identity
[ -f "$helper" ] && [ ! -L "$helper" ] || fail cleanup_helper_type
[ "$(stat -c '\''%d:%i:%u:%g:%a:%s'\'' "$helper")" = "$helper_identity" ] || fail cleanup_helper_identity
printf '\''%s\n'\'' '\''0fe207302d7feb59fe6ff9a6beb407950d9fce9386522b533ad0868514d9e7ed  /home/root/.local/share/pi-ink-bridge/.preflight-reader-0011/metadata-reader'\'' | sha256sum -c -
rm -- "$helper"
rmdir -- "$dir"
printf '\''OWNED_READER_REMOVED\n'\''
'
operations.on_nonzero_or_disconnect: Stop and preserve exact partial helper state. No retry or broader cleanup. Lost connection is not proof that the remote process stopped.

remote_write_allowlist.operation: Create only if absent; root-only mode 0700. Preserve on any failure.

Exclusive new file via noclobber upload; mode 0600; verify exact size and SHA-256; chmod 0700; execute once; remove only after synchronous process return and matching inode/device/owner/mode/size and SHA-256 checks.

remote_cleanup: Only this new helper file and its proven-empty new directory after successful execution and identity/hash revalidation. No trap cleanup; no deletion of old files.

reader_policy.checks: No symlink parents; O_NOFOLLOW nonblocking reads; root-owned 0600 regular files; bounded sizes; descriptor identity before/after read; reject foreign data paths and changed config/server/certificate.
reader_policy.output: File metadata and hashes, hashed device ID, fixed-path/trust booleans only. No token, config/certificate/draft contents or raw device ID.

approval_requested: Approve exactly the two bounded operations and temporary helper lifecycle. Keep the client closed and trust/files stable during this trusted exclusive operation. Any mismatch stops.
